picks.excerpt: Two Minute Papers breaks down Terrain Diffusion — a diffusion-model mod (shipping on Modrinth/GitHub) that generates far richer, more varied Minecraft terrain than the game's hand-tuned noise system. A concrete example of generative AI as a real procedural-content-generation tool a game's modders/designers can actually install and use.
